## Cookies on www.daera-ni.gov.uk

We use some essential cookies to make this service work. We’d like to set additional cookies so we can remember your settings, understand how people use the service and make improvements. Some of our pages allow selected third parties to set cookies – for example, pages that contain YouTube videos or Google Maps.

# Guide centres and facilities

Topics:

- [Forestry](https://www.daera-ni.gov.uk/topics/forestry),
- [Forestry education](https://www.daera-ni.gov.uk/topics/forestry-education)

Forest Service Guides are available at the forests listed below. Details of the facilities available at the forest together with information of educational programmes that have been developed

## Education facilities

### Belvoir Park Forest

Belvoir Park Forest, located at Newtownbreda, Belfast has many facilities available for educational visits including:

- way-marked/nature trails
- guided tours available
- lecture room/classroom
- permanent exhibition
- commercially managed forest
- picnic areas
- toilets (disabled access)

This forest also has an [education programme](https://www.daera-ni.gov.uk/articles/education-programmes)

General information regarding this forest is also available on nidirect.

[Belvoir Park Forest (nidirect website)(external link opens in a new window / tab)external link opens in a new window / tab](http://www.nidirect.gov.uk/belvoir-park-forest)

### Castlewellan Forest Park

Castlewellan Forest Park has many facilities available for educational visits including

- commercially managed forest

This forest also has an [education programme](https://www.daera-ni.gov.uk/articles/education-programmes)

General information regarding this forest is also available on nidirect.

[Castlewellan Forest Park (nidirect website)(external link opens in a new window / tab)external link opens in a new window / tab](http://www.nidirect.gov.uk/castlewellan-forest-park-2)
